node.title: Re^2: Persistent data structures -- why so complicated? (updated)
node.author: erix
node.doctext:
For PostgreSQL jsonb one might mention the advantage of json(b)-indexing: it makes access of large json tables fast (rule of thumb: 100x faster - of course, it only matters for large datasets).

(see [ https://www.postgresql.org/docs/current/datatype-json.html#JSON-INDEXING |the PostgreSQL fine manual on JSON-indexing ])
